'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Chris Schoenthal LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Schoenthal]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Wylron's Hammer'''. Username '''imrahil327'''. Handwritten. LIGHT checked. Line 1 is Tatooine: Slave Quarters; the starting objective is line 2 Communing (no start circle). Line 4 is the combo Commando Training & K'lor'slug. Line 42 written Rogue Squadron Leader → Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader. Line 56 written Tatooine (E2); E2 is a printing note, not (V). An empty box on a ditto is not (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing]]
* '''Username:''' imrahil327
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
